features.name: Audit Trail and Compliance Reporting
features.description: Comprehensive audit trails logging all user actions, system events, data modifications with complete access tracking, change history, pre-built compliance reports (GDPR, SOX, PCI-DSS), tamper-proof logs, and automated suspicious activity alerts

sources.section: Requirement 8: Audit Trail and Compliance Reporting

requirementDetails.userStory: As a Compliance Officer, I want comprehensive audit trails and compliance reports, so that I can demonstrate regulatory compliance and investigate security incidents
acceptanceCriteria: Log all user actions, system events, data modifications with timestamp, user ID, action details
Track who accessed what data and when with complete access audit trail
Maintain complete change history for all data with before/after values
Provide pre-built compliance reports for GDPR, SOX, PCI-DSS
Provide powerful search and filter capabilities across audit logs
Implement configurable log retention policies based on compliance requirements
Ensure audit logs are tamper-proof and immutable using cryptographic hashing or blockchain
Alert security teams automatically when suspicious activity is detected
Provide audit log export capabilities for external analysis and archival
Support compliance reporting for data protection regulations including data access requests and deletion confirmations

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Secure multi-method authentication supporting email/password, social login, magic link, SMS OTP, and biometric with encrypted session tokens, account lockout protection, and login activity tracking

requirementDetails.userStory: As a registered user, I want to securely log in to my account using my preferred authentication method, so that I can access my bookings and personal information
acceptanceCriteria: Support multiple authentication methods: email/password, social login, magic link, SMS OTP, biometric
Validate credentials against securely hashed passwords
Generate encrypted session token with user ID, role, expiration
Store session token in HTTP-only, secure, SameSite cookie for web
Return session token in API response for mobile secure storage
Extend session to 30 days with 'Remember Me' (configurable to 400 days for corporate)
Lock account for 30 minutes after 5 failed login attempts in 15 minutes
Send notification email for login from new device or location
Auto-logout and redirect to login page when session expires
Record login activity with timestamp, device, IP, location for audit

features.name: Corporate Single Sign-On (SSO)
features.description: Enterprise SSO integration supporting SAML 2.0 and OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect for corporate identity providers with automatic account provisioning and session management

requirementDetails.userStory: As a corporate employee, I want to log in using my company credentials, so that I don't need to manage separate passwords and can comply with corporate security policies
acceptanceCriteria: Support SAML 2.0 and OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect protocols for corporate identity providers
Redirect corporate user to identity provider's login page
Receive and validate authentication assertion with user identity and attributes
Validate signature and expiration of SSO assertion
Auto-create account and assign to corporate organization on first SSO login
Auto-logout and redirect to SSO login when corporate session expires
Deny access when corporate administrator disables user in identity provider
Display error message and corporate IT helpdesk contact when SSO fails

features.name: Account Security Management
features.description: Comprehensive account security settings including password management, active session management, login history, suspicious activity alerts, and account deactivation with session invalidation

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want to manage my account security settings and monitor account activity, so that I can protect my account from unauthorized access
acceptanceCriteria: Display security settings: change password, update email/phone, manage sessions, view login history
Require current password verification before allowing password change
Enforce password strength requirements (min 8 chars, mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, special chars)
Invalidate all existing sessions except current when password changed, send confirmation email
Display active sessions with device type, browser, OS, IP, location, last activity timestamp
Invalidate specific session token and logout user on that device when session terminated
Invalidate all session tokens except current when 'Log out all devices' selected
Display last 50 login attempts with timestamp, device, location, success/failure status
Send email alert with details and account security link when suspicious login activity detected
Verify no active bookings, mark account inactive, send confirmation email when account deactivation requested

features.name: Privacy Controls and Data Management
features.description: GDPR/CCPA-compliant privacy controls including data visibility settings, partner data sharing opt-out, marketing opt-out, data export, account deletion with grace period, cookie preferences, and clear privacy policy

sources.section: REQ-UM-013: Privacy Controls and Data Management

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user concerned about privacy, I want to control how my personal data is used and shared, so that I can protect my privacy while using the platform
acceptanceCriteria: Display controls for data visibility, location tracking, data sharing, marketing communications
Not share personal information with third parties (except service delivery: payment, insurance) when opted out of data sharing
Suppress promotional emails, SMS, push notifications while continuing transactional communications when opted out of marketing
Generate machine-readable export (JSON/CSV) with all personal info, bookings, payments, communications within 30 days
Verify no active bookings or outstanding payments before proceeding with account deletion
Provide 30-day grace period for account restoration when account deletion confirmed
Permanently delete account and personal data after grace period, retain only legally required info
Send confirmation email explaining retained data and reasons when account deleted
Respect user choices for analytics, advertising, functional cookies when managing cookie preferences
Display privacy policy in clear, accessible language with sections on data collection, usage, sharing, user rights

features.name: Decentralized Identity (DID) Integration
features.description: Blockchain-based portable identity supporting W3C DID standards, verifiable credentials, cryptographic signature verification, portable reputation scores, selective disclosure, and redundant verification skip

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user who rents from multiple platforms, I want to use a portable digital identity, so that I can build a reputation that follows me across services and skip redundant verifications
acceptanceCriteria: Support W3C DID standards and common wallet providers (uPort, Civic, Microsoft ION)
Verify cryptographic signatures on verifiable credentials without accessing raw personal data
Validate credential authenticity by checking issuer signature and blockchain anchor
Display portable reputation score from other platforms and use for trust decisions
Issue verifiable credentials representing rental history and reliability when user builds reputation
Support selective disclosure allowing users to prove attributes (e.g., 'over 25') without revealing exact data
Skip redundant verification steps (license upload, KYC) when equivalent DID credentials validated
Stop accessing DID-based credentials and fall back to traditional verification when user revokes DID access

features.name: Accessibility Compliance
features.description: Screen reader compatibility with semantic HTML and ARIA labels, full keyboard navigation, sufficient color contrast (WCAG AA 4.5:1), font size preference support, descriptive alt text for images, captions/transcripts for video, proper form label association, clear focus indicators, voice control support, text alternatives for non-text content, screen reader error announcements, and WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user with disabilities, I want an accessible search interface, so that I can search for vehicles independently using assistive technologies
acceptanceCriteria: Provide screen reader compatibility with proper semantic HTML and ARIA labels
Support full keyboard navigation for all search functions
Maintain sufficient color contrast ratios (WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1)
Respect user font size preferences and support text scaling
Provide descriptive alt text for all vehicle images
Provide captions and transcripts for video content
Ensure form labels are properly associated with input fields
Provide clear focus indicators for keyboard navigation
Support voice control for search on compatible devices
Provide text alternatives for all non-text content
Ensure error messages are announced to screen readers
Meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance standards

features.name: API Key Management and Security
features.description: Store mapping API keys in environment variables, use separate keys for dev/prod, implement key rotation policies (annually), monitor API usage and costs, set usage quotas and alerts, restrict keys to specific domains/IPs, implement rate limiting, log all API requests, alert on budget threshold exceeded, and document key compromise response procedures

sources.section: Requirement 11: API Key Management and Security

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want secure management of mapping service API keys, so that unauthorized usage is prevented and costs are controlled
acceptanceCriteria: Store mapping API keys in environment variables, not in code
Use separate API keys for development and production environments
Implement API key rotation policies (minimum annually)
Monitor API usage and costs through provider dashboards
Set usage quotas and alerts for cost control
Restrict API keys to specific domains and IP addresses
Implement rate limiting to prevent API abuse
Log all mapping API requests for audit and debugging
Alert operations team when API usage exceeds budget threshold
Have documented procedures for API key compromise response

features.name: Privacy and Permissions
features.description: Request location permission with clear explanation, provide value before requesting permission, respect permission denial without degrading core functionality, allow permission revocation, minimize location data retention (delete after session unless consent), anonymize location data for analytics, comply with GDPR/CCPA, provide transparency in privacy policy, no third-party sharing without consent, and allow location history deletion

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want control over my location data, so that my privacy is respected and I understand how my location is used
acceptanceCriteria: Request location permission with clear explanation of usage
Provide value before requesting location permission
Respect location permission denial without degrading core functionality
Allow users to revoke location permission at any time
Minimize location data retention (delete after session unless consent given)
Anonymize location data for analytics purposes
Comply with GDPR and CCPA location data requirements
Provide transparency about location data usage in privacy policy
Not share location data with third parties without explicit consent
Allow users to delete their location history

features.name: Regulatory Compliance
features.description: Obtain explicit opt-in consent for marketing, provide clear opt-out mechanisms, honor opt-out within 10 business days (CAN-SPAM), include sender identification, maintain consent records for audit, comply with GDPR (EU), TCPA (US SMS), CASL (Canada), respect quiet hours (9 PM - 8 AM local), provide data portability for preferences, allow notification history deletion, and document compliance in privacy policy

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want notification practices to comply with regulations, so that the platform avoids penalties and maintains customer trust
acceptanceCriteria: Obtain explicit opt-in consent before sending marketing communications
Provide clear opt-out mechanisms in all marketing messages
Honor opt-out requests within 10 business days (CAN-SPAM requirement)
Include sender identification in all messages
Maintain consent records for audit purposes
Comply with GDPR requirements for EU customers
Comply with TCPA requirements for US SMS
Comply with CASL requirements for Canadian customers
Respect quiet hours (no SMS/push between 9 PM - 8 AM local time)
Provide data portability for notification preferences
Allow users to delete their notification history
Document compliance procedures in privacy policy

features.name: Payment Fraud Prevention System
features.description: Implement fraud detection with gateway-provided features, 3D Secure, AVS checks, velocity limits, and device fingerprinting

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want to detect and prevent fraudulent transactions, so that chargebacks are minimized and legitimate customers are protected.
acceptanceCriteria: Enables gateway-provided fraud detection features (Stripe Radar, PayPal Fraud Protection)
Implements 3D Secure authentication for high-value transactions (>$500)
Performs Address Verification System (AVS) checks for card payments
Implements velocity checks to limit transaction frequency per user
Maintains blacklist of fraudulent users and payment methods
Flags transactions for manual review when fraud is detected
Implements device fingerprinting to identify suspicious patterns
Monitors for unusual booking patterns (multiple bookings from same IP)
Requires additional verification for high-risk transactions
Tracks chargeback rates and fraud losses for continuous improvement

features.name: Multi-Channel Authentication
features.description: Support multiple authentication methods including email/password, social login, and two-factor authentication

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user of the car rental platform, I want my personal information, payment data, and account to be protected by robust security measures, so that I can use the service with confidence and without fear of fraud or data breaches.
acceptanceCriteria: Email and password authentication with strong password requirements
Social login (Google, Facebook, Apple) integration
Two-factor authentication (2FA) option for enhanced security
Password reset via secure email verification
Account lockout after 5 failed login attempts

features.name: Strong Password Security
features.description: Enforce strong password requirements and secure storage with bcrypt or Argon2 hashing

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want my password to be stored securely to protect my account.
acceptanceCriteria: Minimum password length of 8 characters
Passwords must include uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character
Passwords are hashed using bcrypt or Argon2 with appropriate cost factor
Passwords are salted with unique salt per user
Password history prevents reuse of last 5 passwords

features.name: JWT Token Security
features.description: Use JSON Web Tokens for stateless authentication with appropriate security controls and expiration

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want secure token-based authentication for scalable, stateless sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: JWTs are signed with strong secret keys (minimum 256 bits)
Access tokens expire within 15 minutes
Refresh tokens expire within 7 days
Tokens include user ID, roles, and expiration claims
Token revocation mechanism exists for compromised accounts

features.name: Digital KYC and Liveness Checks
features.description: Implement digital Know Your Customer processes with liveness detection to prevent fraud

sources.section: REQ-SEC-5: Digital KYC and Liveness Checks

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want digital KYC with liveness detection to prevent identity fraud.
acceptanceCriteria: OCR scans driver's licenses and passports automatically
Liveness checks detect live humans vs photos or videos
Facial recognition matches selfie to ID photo
Passive liveness checks analyze micro-reflections
Failed verification attempts are logged and reviewed

features.name: Resource-Level Authorization
features.description: Verify user permissions to access specific resources (bookings, vehicles, reports) on every request

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want my data protected so only I can access my bookings and information.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can only view their own bookings (unless admin)
Suppliers can only manage their own vehicles
Fleet managers can only access their assigned locations
API endpoints verify resource ownership before returning data
Authorization checks occur on every request

features.name: API Authentication and Authorization
features.description: Authenticate and authorize all API requests with API keys or OAuth tokens

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want secure API access to prevent unauthorized usage.
acceptanceCriteria: API keys or OAuth tokens required for all API access
API rate limiting prevents abuse
API permissions are scoped to specific operations
API access is logged for audit purposes
Compromised API keys can be revoked immediately

features.name: Encryption in Transit (TLS/HTTPS)
features.description: Encrypt all data transmitted between clients and servers using TLS 1.2 or higher

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want my data encrypted during transmission to prevent interception.
acceptanceCriteria: TLS 1.2 or higher is enforced for all connections
HTTP requests are automatically redirected to HTTPS
Strong cipher suites are configured (no weak ciphers)
Valid SSL/TLS certificates from trusted authorities
Certificate expiration monitoring and automatic renewal

features.name: Encryption at Rest
features.description: Encrypt sensitive data at rest in databases and file storage using AES-256

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want data encrypted at rest to protect against storage compromise.
acceptanceCriteria: Database encryption is enabled for all sensitive tables
Payment information is encrypted with strong algorithms (AES-256)
Personal identification documents are encrypted in storage
Encryption keys are managed securely (key management service)
Encryption key rotation occurs annually

features.name: PII Protection
features.description: Implement appropriate protection measures for Personally Identifiable Information with encryption and access logging

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want my personal information protected according to privacy regulations.
acceptanceCriteria: PII is encrypted at rest and in transit
PII access is logged and audited
PII is masked in logs and error messages
PII is segregated from non-sensitive data where possible
PII retention policies are enforced automatically

features.name: Payment Data Security (PCI-DSS)
features.description: Comply with PCI-DSS requirements for payment card data handling

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want PCI-DSS compliance to handle payment data securely.
acceptanceCriteria: Credit card numbers are never stored in plain text
Hosted checkout pages reduce PCI scope
Payment tokenization is used for recurring charges
PCI-DSS compliance is validated annually
Payment data is segregated from other application data

features.name: Input Validation and Sanitization
features.description: Validate and sanitize all user input to prevent injection attacks (SQL, XSS, command injection)

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want input validation to prevent common attacks.
acceptanceCriteria: All user input is validated against expected formats
SQL injection is prevented through parameterized queries
XSS attacks are prevented through output encoding
File uploads are validated for type and size
Input validation occurs on both client and server

features.name: CSRF Protection
features.description: Implement Cross-Site Request Forgery protection for all state-changing operations

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want protection from CSRF attacks that could trick me into unwanted actions.
acceptanceCriteria: CSRF tokens are generated for each user session
CSRF tokens are validated on all POST, PUT, DELETE requests
CSRF tokens are included in forms and AJAX requests
Failed CSRF validation results in request rejection
CSRF protection is tested regularly

features.name: Rate Limiting and Throttling
features.description: Implement rate limiting to prevent abuse and denial-of-service attacks

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want rate limiting to prevent brute force and DoS attacks.
acceptanceCriteria: API endpoints have appropriate rate limits (e.g., 100 requests/minute)
Login attempts are rate limited (5 attempts per 15 minutes)
Password reset requests are rate limited
Rate limit violations return 429 Too Many Requests
Rate limits are configurable per endpoint and user type

features.name: Security Headers
features.description: Implement security headers to protect against common web vulnerabilities

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want security headers for defense-in-depth.
acceptanceCriteria: Content-Security-Policy header prevents XSS
X-Frame-Options header prevents clickjacking
X-Content-Type-Options header prevents MIME sniffing
Strict-Transport-Security header enforces HTTPS
Referrer-Policy header controls referrer information

features.name: Security Event Logging
features.description: Log all security-relevant events for audit and forensic purposes

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want comprehensive security logging for incident response.
acceptanceCriteria: Login attempts (successful and failed) are logged
Authorization failures are logged
Data access to sensitive resources is logged
Configuration changes are logged
Logs include timestamp, user ID, IP address, and action

features.name: Blockchain Audit Trail
features.description: Use blockchain for immutable audit trails of critical events (bookings, payments, damage reports)

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want blockchain audit trails for tamper-proof records.
acceptanceCriteria: Critical events (bookings, payments, damage reports) are hashed and stored on-chain
Blockchain records are immutable and tamper-evident
Audit trail provides chain of custody for disputes
Blockchain records are accessible for verification
Blockchain implementation does not impact performance

features.name: Log Protection
features.description: Protect log files from unauthorized access and tampering with access controls and integrity verification

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want protected logs to ensure audit trails remain reliable.
acceptanceCriteria: Logs are stored in secure, access-controlled locations
Log access is restricted to authorized personnel
Log integrity is verified through checksums or signatures
Logs are backed up regularly
Log retention policies comply with regulatory requirements

features.name: Account Takeover Prevention
features.description: Detect and prevent account takeover attempts with device verification and unusual activity alerts

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want protection from unauthorized access to my account.
acceptanceCriteria: Login from new devices triggers verification
Unusual login patterns (location, time) trigger alerts
Password changes require current password or email verification
Email/phone changes require verification
Users are notified of security-relevant account changes

features.name: Security Testing
features.description: Conduct regular security testing including automated scanning and annual penetration testing

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want regular security testing to identify vulnerabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Automated security scanning runs with each deployment
Penetration testing occurs at least annually
Dependency vulnerability scanning runs daily
Security findings are prioritized and remediated
Security test results are documented and tracked

features.name: Dependency Management
features.description: Manage third-party dependencies to prevent known vulnerabilities with scanning and patching

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want proactive dependency management to reduce vulnerability risk.
acceptanceCriteria: Dependency versions are tracked and documented
Known vulnerabilities are identified through scanning
Critical vulnerabilities are patched within 7 days
High-severity vulnerabilities are patched within 30 days
Dependency updates are tested before deployment

features.name: Incident Response Plan
features.description: Maintain documented incident response procedures for security breaches with breach notification compliance

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want incident response procedures to minimize breach damage.
acceptanceCriteria: Incident response plan is documented and tested
Security incidents are detected and escalated promptly
Incident response team is identified and trained
Breach notification procedures comply with regulations
Post-incident reviews identify improvements

features.name: Smart Contract Security
features.description: Ensure smart contracts are secure and audited before deployment with proper access controls

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator using blockchain, I want secure smart contracts to prevent financial losses.
acceptanceCriteria: Smart contracts undergo security audits before deployment
Smart contracts are tested extensively
Smart contract upgradability is considered in design
Smart contract access controls are properly implemented
Smart contract events are monitored for anomalies
